display.title: Episode 502: A Peek at the Third Beis HaMikdash
display.summary_short: Welcoming new Tzivos Hashem soldiers, Shema with an eleven-year-old guest, and little Levi's dream of a spaceship ride to see the third Beis HaMikdash.
display.summary_long: Uncle Yossi welcomes the many new members who joined Tzivos Hashem after hearing the program, explains that even a newborn baby can join, and teaches about zechus harabim: a good deed done together with hundreds of thousands of children carries a special merit. After the Hakochainik march, an eleven-year-old girl from a Boro Park girls' school leads the Shema and everyone gives tzedakah. Story time: Levi comes home excited because his rebbe taught that Hashem has already built the third Beis HaMikdash in Heaven and lowers it a little with every mitzvah. His father adds that it will last forever because Hashem Himself built it, and that Rabbi Levi Yitzchak of Berditchev said tzaddikim are shown it on Shabbos Chazon. That night Levi dreams that 'Flight 770' lands in his backyard and takes him to see the Beis HaMikdash, but he stays too long and the spaceship leaves without him, until he wakes up in tears beside his parents. We can make the dream come true by learning more Torah and doing more mitzvos. The mailbox brings two brothers' request to visit Studio 604 and a question about why we smell spices at Havdalah, followed by candle-lighting times now that the clocks have been turned back.
display.lesson: Every bit of Torah and every mitzvah brings the third Beis HaMikdash closer, so we can make Levi's dream come true.

date.note: Clocks just turned back; candles 4:21, Shabbos ends 5:23 fit mid-November 1991 in New York; refers to last week's mezuzah letter (episode 501). Weekly run to 504 (19 Kislev).
